67	function(generate_bootloader_config)

82	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHSIZE_4MB=1\n")
83	  endif()
84	
85	  # Flash mode configuration
86	  if(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_MODE_DIO)
87	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHMODE_DIO=1\n")
88	  endif()
89	  if(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_MODE_DOUT)
90	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHMODE_DOUT=1\n")
91	  endif()
92	  if(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_MODE_QIO)
93	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHMODE_QIO=1\n")
94	  endif()
95	  if(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_MODE_QOUT)
96	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHMODE_QOUT=1\n")
97	  endif()
98	
99	  # Flash frequency configuration
100	  if(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_FREQ_80M)
101	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHFREQ_80M=1\n")
102	  endif()
103	  if(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_FREQ_64M)
104	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHFREQ_64M=1\n")
105	  endif()
106	  if(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_FREQ_48M)
107	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHFREQ_48M=1\n")
108	  endif()
109	  if(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_FREQ_40M)
110	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHFREQ_40M=1\n")
111	  endif()
112	  if(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_FREQ_26M)
113	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHFREQ_26M=1\n")
114	  endif()
115	  if(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_FREQ_20M)
116	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHFREQ_20M=1\n")
117	  endif()
118	  if(DEFINED CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_FREQ)
119	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT
120	           "CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHFREQ=${CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_FREQ}\n")
121	  endif()
122	
123	  # MCUboot specific configuration
124	  if(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_BOOTLOADER_MCUBOOT)
125	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_BOOTLOADER_MCUBOOT=1\n")
126	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESP_BOOTLOADER_OFFSET=0x0000\n")
127	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESP_BOOTLOADER_SIZE=0xF000\n")
128	    string(
129	      APPEND
130	      CONFIG_CONTENT
131	      "CONFIG_ESP_IMAGE0_PRIMARY_START_ADDRESS=${CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_OTA_PRIMARY_SLOT_OFFSET}\n"
132	    )
133	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT
134	           "CONFIG_ESP_APPLICATION_SIZE=${CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_OTA_SLOT_SIZE}\n")
135	    string(
136	      APPEND
137	      CONFIG_CONTENT
138	      "CONFIG_ESP_IMAGE0_SECONDARY_START_ADDRESS=${CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_OTA_SECONDARY_SLOT_OFFSET}\n"
139	    )
140	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESP_MCUBOOT_WDT_ENABLE=1\n")
141	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_LIBC_NEWLIB=1\n")
142	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT
143	           "CONFIG_ESP_SCRATCH_OFFSET=${CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_OTA_SCRATCH_OFFSET}\n")
144	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT
145	           "CONFIG_ESP_SCRATCH_SIZE=${CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_OTA_SCRATCH_SIZE}\n")
146	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESP_CONSOLE_UART=1\n")
147	
148	    # UART console configuration
149	    if(CONFIG_UART0_SERIAL_CONSOLE)
150	      string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESP_CONSOLE_UART_NUM=0\n")
151	      string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESP_CONSOLE_ROM_SERIAL_PORT_NUM=0\n")
152	    endif()
153	    if(CONFIG_UART1_SERIAL_CONSOLE)
154	      string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESP_CONSOLE_UART_NUM=1\n")

156	    endif()
157	    if(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_USBSERIAL)
158	      string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_ESP_CONSOLE_UART_NUM=0\n")
159	    endif()
160	
161	    # Secure flash encryption configuration
162	    if(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_SECURE_FLASH_ENC_ENABLED)
163	      string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_SECURE_FLASH_ENC_ENABLED=1\n")
164	    endif()
165	    if(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_SECURE_FLASH_ENCRYPTION_MODE_DEVELOPMENT)
166	      string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT
167	             "CONFIG_SECURE_FLASH_ENCRYPTION_MODE_DEVELOPMENT=1\n")

171	             "CONFIG_SECURE_FLASH_UART_BOOTLOADER_ALLOW_ENC=1\n")
172	    endif()
173	    if(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_SECURE_FLASH_UART_BOOTLOADER_ALLOW_DEC)
174	      string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT
175	             "CONFIG_SECURE_FLASH_UART_BOOTLOADER_ALLOW_DEC=1\n")

178	      string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT
179	             "CONFIG_SECURE_FLASH_UART_BOOTLOADER_ALLOW_CACHE=1\n")
180	    endif()
181	
182	    string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_BOOTLOADER_LOG_LEVEL=3\n")
183	
184	    # EFUSE virtual configuration

187	      string(APPEND CONFIG_CONTENT "CONFIG_EFUSE_VIRTUAL_KEEP_IN_FLASH=1\n")

195	        CONFIG_CONTENT
196	        "CONFIG_EFUSE_VIRTUAL_SIZE=${CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_EFUSE_VIRTUAL_KEEP_IN_FLASH_SIZE}\n"
197	      )
198	    endif()
199	  endif()
200	
201	  # Write configuration file
202	  file(WRITE ${BOOTLOADER_CONFIG} ${CONFIG_CONTENT})
203	endfunction()

在 contest 版本中，`espressif_common.cmake` 是从 `chip/esp32p4/CMakeLists.txt` include 进来的，所以 `CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR` 指向 `chip/esp32p4/`，这正好是 contest 自己的 `Bootloader.cmake` 所在目录。**这是正确的**。

但 `Wireless.cmake` 使用的是：
```cmake
include(${ESPRESSIF_COMMON_DIR}/Wireless.cmake)
```

这里引用的是上游的 `Wireless.cmake`（因为 contest 目录下没有自己的 `Wireless.cmake`）。**这也是正确的**。

### 四、编译能否通过的判断

**基本可以编译通过**，前提是：

1. 不启用 `CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LP_MAILBOX`（CMake 遗漏）
2. 不启用 `CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_USE_LP_CORE`（CMake 不支持）
3. `ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION` 对应的 commit 可以正常 clone 和编译
4. mbedtls patch 文件存在于 esp-hal-3rdparty 仓库中

**可能编译失败的场景**：
- 如果 nuttx 主线的 `Wireless.cmake` 更新了（比如新增了源文件或条件），contest 版本会自动继承这些变化（因为它引用的是上游文件），这可能导致不兼容
- 如果 `hal_esp32p4.cmake` 更新了，contest 版本也需要同步更新（目前是同步的）

### 五、建议

1. **同步 `ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION`**：考虑将 CMake 版本更新为与 Make.defs 相同的 commit `b90b1837cb5ad24747deb4c895246037cc206ce5`
2. **考虑是否需要同步 Make.defs 中的 `esp_lp_mailbox.c`**：如果需要此功能，需要在 CMake 中添加
3. **mbedtls patch 的幂等性**：确保 patch 不会重复应用失败，或者在 CMake 中加入条件判断
